shared.massPolicy: Keep source 2435 kg; package-specific real mass unknown. No limited-edition weight reduction.
shared.powertrainPolicy: Keep original motor/drivetrain/ABS/regen approximation. Native TC uses nine experimental slip thresholds. ESC/TVC are predictions, not active actuators.

air.name: Xiaomi SU7 Ultra Air - Dev
air.fidelity: Source fixed spring/damper set is an assumed single operating-point air-suspension surrogate; no dual-chamber switching, self-leveling or CDC.

coilover.name: Xiaomi SU7 Ultra Track Coilover - Dev
coilover.fidelity: Explicit engineering assumptions relative to source: higher wheel rates, matching sqrt(k) damping scaling, ARB change and rod offset. Not OEM Bilstein spring/damper values; static change is not proven 10 mm actual ride-height reduction.

active.fidelity: Source rear aero rescaled as an active-wing surrogate; span from local mesh. Coefficients are assumptions, not CFD or measurements.

fixed.fidelity: Use source rear aero at fixed original angle, remove active motion; original lumped rear aero remains uncalibrated.

pt01.name: Sailun PT01 (Experimental)
pt01.sizeCaveat: Catalog confirms sizes, not identity of regional compound with Ultra OEM formulation. Loaded radii inherited from mod.
pt01.basis: Trofeo RS source surrogate; all unknowns explicitly retained as borrowed or assumed.
pt01.borrowed: Pressure, mass/inertia, stiffness, heat-transfer, wear, relaxation, load sensitivity and wet physics retained from donor; none is a PT01 measurement.
pt01.unknown: OEM friction/force curves, pressure/temperature window, tyre mass, wear, load index and wet behavior. No claim of superiority over Trofeo RS.

selectionPolicy: Suspension, wing and tyre selections are independent. Hardware changes before session; all tyres selectable in native pit setup.

electronics.source: User-specified integer ranges/directions; strengths and slip limits are engineering assumptions
